analyses.title: Demand, sales and profit by product

accepted.headline: Espresso is your top profit driver
accepted.explanation: Espresso is ranked rank 1 with 339 units sold, generating grossProfit of 48701.75 and a marginPct of 86.2.
accepted.action: Ensure uninterrupted stock and machine maintenance for Espresso as it leads total café profitability.

accepted.headline: Karamel latte demand is dropping sharply
accepted.explanation: Weekly sales for Karamel latte fell by -82.05% from week 1 (39 units) to the last full week (7 units), and recent weekly units went from 22 down to 7.
accepted.action: Review recipe popularity or consider replacing Karamel latte with a seasonal special.

accepted.headline: Makijato delivers strong second-place earnings
accepted.explanation: Makijato holds rank 2 with 220 units sold and a grossProfit of 34286.24, alongside a currentProfitPerUnit of 152.
accepted.action: Keep promoting Makijato alongside standard Espresso combos.

accepted.headline: Jogurt 180 g has very low profit margin
accepted.explanation: Jogurt 180 g has the lowest marginPct at 45 and a weak grossProfit of 1227.27, earning only 61.36 currentProfitPerUnit.
accepted.action: Evaluate whether to reprice Jogurt 180 g or remove it from the menu.

accepted.headline: Monthly result turned negative after price rises and cost increases
accepted.explanation: The monthly run-rate result dropped to -16998.72 using the formula (177307.35 / 16) × 30 − 349450, driven by higher fixed costs and increased cost of goods sold.
accepted.action: Review menu pricing across all flagged drink items to protect margins and offset fixed cost inflation.

accepted.headline: Major supplier price surge for espresso coffee beans
accepted.explanation: The purchase price for Espresso kafa u zrnu 1 kg rose significantly from 2450 to 3480, representing a 42.04 percent increase.
accepted.action: Negotiate with your coffee supplier or explore alternative beans to mitigate the heavy impact on espresso-based drinks.

accepted.headline: Significant margin compression on Kafa latte
accepted.explanation: The margin percentage for Kafa latte dropped from 76.31 to 68.32 because recipe costs increased from 57.25 to 76.56 against a net price of 241.67.
accepted.action: Increase the menu price of Kafa latte to preserve profitability against rising dairy and coffee input costs.

accepted.headline: Sharp rise in electricity expenses
accepted.explanation: Monthly electricity costs jumped from 28000 to 46000, adding an 18000 delta to fixed overheads.
accepted.action: Audit energy usage during off-peak hours and check equipment efficiency to control utility bills.

accepted.headline: New maintenance expenses introduced
accepted.explanation: Maintenance costs rose from 0 to 18000 with an 18000 delta for the month.
accepted.action: Track equipment servicing requirements closely to prevent unexpected repair bills from recurring.

accepted.explanation: Makijato holds rank 2 with 220 units sold and a grossProfit of 34286.24, alongside a currentProfitPerUnit of 152.

accepted.action: Evaluate whether to reprice Jogurt 180 g or remove it from the menu.

accepted.headline: Monthly result turned negative after price rises and cost increases
accepted.explanation: The monthly run-rate result dropped to -16998.72 using the formula (177307.35 / 16) × 30 − 349450, driven by higher fixed costs and increased cost of goods sold.
accepted.action: Review menu pricing across all flagged drink items to protect margins and offset fixed cost inflation.

accepted.headline: Major supplier price surge for espresso coffee beans
accepted.explanation: The purchase price for Espresso kafa u zrnu 1 kg rose significantly from 2450 to 3480, representing a 42.04 percent increase.
accepted.action: Negotiate with your coffee supplier or explore alternative beans to mitigate the heavy impact on espresso-based drinks.

accepted.headline: Significant margin compression on Kafa latte
accepted.explanation: The margin percentage for Kafa latte dropped from 76.31 to 68.32 because recipe costs increased from 57.25 to 76.56 against a net price of 241.67.
accepted.action: Increase the menu price of Kafa latte to preserve profitability against rising dairy and coffee input costs.

accepted.headline: Sharp rise in electricity expenses
accepted.explanation: Monthly electricity costs jumped from 28000 to 46000, adding an 18000 delta to fixed overheads.
accepted.action: Audit energy usage during off-peak hours and check equipment efficiency to control utility bills.

accepted.headline: New maintenance expenses introduced

analyses.title: Demand, sales and profit by product

accepted.headline: Espresso is your top profit driver
accepted.explanation: Espresso is ranked rank 1 with 339 units sold, generating grossProfit of 48701.75 and a marginPct of 86.2.
accepted.action: Ensure uninterrupted stock and machine maintenance for Espresso as it leads total café profitability.

accepted.headline: Karamel latte demand is dropping sharply
accepted.explanation: Weekly sales for Karamel latte fell by -82.05% from week 1 (39 units) to the last full week (7 units), and recent weekly units went from 22 down to 7.
accepted.action: Review recipe popularity or consider replacing Karamel latte with a seasonal special.

accepted.headline: Makijato delivers strong second-place earnings
accepted.explanation: Makijato holds rank 2 with 220 units sold and a grossProfit of 34286.24, alongside a currentProfitPerUnit of 152.
accepted.action: Keep promoting Makijato alongside standard Espresso combos.

accepted.headline: Jogurt 180 g has very low profit margin
accepted.explanation: Jogurt 180 g has the lowest marginPct at 45 and a weak grossProfit of 1227.27, earning only 61.36 currentProfitPerUnit.
accepted.action: Evaluate whether to reprice Jogurt 180 g or remove it from the menu.

accepted.headline: Monthly result turned negative after price rises and cost increases
accepted.explanation: The monthly run-rate result dropped to -16998.72 using the formula (177307.35 / 16) × 30 − 349450, driven by higher fixed costs and increased cost of goods sold.
accepted.action: Review menu pricing across all flagged drink items to protect margins and offset fixed cost inflation.

accepted.headline: Major supplier price surge for espresso coffee beans
accepted.explanation: The purchase price for Espresso kafa u zrnu 1 kg rose significantly from 2450 to 3480, representing a 42.04 percent increase.
accepted.action: Negotiate with your coffee supplier or explore alternative beans to mitigate the heavy impact on espresso-based drinks.

accepted.headline: Significant margin compression on Kafa latte
accepted.explanation: The margin percentage for Kafa latte dropped from 76.31 to 68.32 because recipe costs increased from 57.25 to 76.56 against a net price of 241.67.
accepted.action: Increase the menu price of Kafa latte to preserve profitability against rising dairy and coffee input costs.

accepted.headline: Sharp rise in electricity expenses
accepted.explanation: Monthly electricity costs jumped from 28000 to 46000, adding an 18000 delta to fixed overheads.
accepted.action: Audit energy usage during off-peak hours and check equipment efficiency to control utility bills.

accepted.headline: New maintenance expenses introduced
accepted.explanation: Maintenance costs rose from 0 to 18000 with an 18000 delta for the month.
accepted.action: Track equipment servicing requirements closely to prevent unexpected repair bills from recurring.

accepted.headline: Monthly result turned negative after price rises and cost increases

accepted.headline: Major supplier price surge for espresso coffee beans

accepted.headline: Makijato delivers strong second-place earnings
accepted.explanation: Makijato holds rank 2 with 220 units sold and a grossProfit of 34286.24, alongside a currentProfitPerUnit of 152.

accepted.headline: Monthly result turned negative after price rises and cost increases
accepted.explanation: The monthly run-rate result dropped to -16998.72 using the formula (177307.35 / 16) × 30 − 349450, driven by higher fixed costs and increased cost of goods sold.
accepted.action: Review menu pricing across all flagged drink items to protect margins and offset fixed cost inflation.

accepted.headline: Major supplier price surge for espresso coffee beans
accepted.explanation: The purchase price for Espresso kafa u zrnu 1 kg rose significantly from 2450 to 3480, representing a 42.04 percent increase.

accepted.headline: Significant margin compression on Kafa latte

accepted.action: Increase the menu price of Kafa latte to preserve profitability against rising dairy and coffee input costs.

accepted.headline: Sharp rise in electricity expenses

accepted.action: Increase the menu price of Kafa latte to preserve profitability against rising dairy and coffee input costs.

accepted.headline: Sharp rise in electricity expenses
accepted.explanation: Monthly electricity costs jumped from 28000 to 46000, adding an 18000 delta to fixed overheads.
accepted.action: Audit energy usage during off-peak hours and check equipment efficiency to control utility bills.

accepted.headline: New maintenance expenses introduced
